note: Local rehearsal only: Hardhat chain 4441 in process, PGlite for Neon, every api/*.mjs handler in process, public fixture keys. Nothing touched LiteForge, Vercel or production Neon; JACKPOT_LIVE was not flipped.

stack.rules: design §A.5 launch rules; the first epoch adminClearOnly = true, adminClearOnly = false from the next week (operator schedule-rules)

scenarios.title: Happy path: 10,000 tCHIKUN, 3 players, the keeper selects at C + 2 h and clears; anyone finalizes at C + 24 h
Challenge: the keeper misses the best session; the player submits it at C + 8 h and is paid
Flag → admin: a scripted-pilot leader is flagged; the admin disqualifies it and #2 is paid
Flag → admin (replay variant): the admin clears the flagged leader and it is paid
Integrity: a record without Neon evidence, submitted publicly, is flagged integrity and never auto-paid
Rollover: an unwon funded week rolls into the next, whose payout pays both
Late settlement at C + 6 h + 1 s: SETTLED_LATE on chain, excluded by selection, still on the board
notes: Documented divergence (design B.5 item 10): the weekly board ranks the late run first; the jackpot excludes it (SETTLED_LATE).

scenarios.title: Extension: the admin extends by 12 h; the late run qualifies and is paid at C + 36 h

checks.detail: R7 continues the week of R6

scenarios.title: Prize cap scheduled the week before: the cap is paid, the excess reaches the current week

checks.detail: up to 1,000 tCHIKUN; the rest rolls over

scenarios.title: Token failure: a blacklisted winner is claim-pending, then claims to another address and is paid
Crash recovery: faults at after-cas, after-broadcast and before-receipt, no duplicate transactions
notes: keeper faults: {"after-cas":"clear","after-broadcast":"clear","before-receipt":"clear"}; the after-cas action (recorded, never broadcast) is found dropped once the 180 s receipt window passes and re-signed, its unused nonce taken by the next send (no gap); the other two confirm from chain state.

scenarios.title: Pause, hold and staff: pause and hold stop payouts only; staff and blocked wallets are never candidates
Unfunded week: no keeper transaction, no amount in the API or the UI

detail.rewards: Weekly Jackpot: no prize funded this week
detail.rewardsDetail: Top verified Ranked score of the week wins. See the rules.

scenarios.title: Sybil eviction: five decoys displace the honest top 5; disqualified; honest rows re-listed; the honest leader is paid
notes: Implementation reality: decoys settled before the cutoff are in the keeper's last re-select (cutoff + 10 min), so the keeper lists and flags them itself about 5 h before an attacker could at C + 11 h 59 min; the R13 variant forces the literal C + 11 h 59 min timing.

scenarios.title: Sybil eviction at C + 11 h 59 min, and the never-listed honest #6 added by adminSubmit and paid
Banked-session sniping: a Sunday session settled at C + 5 h just above the leader is held by H9
Non-stock client (maxTicks 108,000): never submitted by the keeper, flagged integrity when submitted
Expected miss: an exceptional-model bot passes the screen and is paid (design B.5 residual)

expectedMisses.population: exceptional-model bot on a real seed (design B.4 set (b), B.5 item 1)
expectedMisses.outcome: cleared by the keeper and paid
expectedMisses.note: The documented residual: a careful in-view bot is indistinguishable from an elite human by these features. Not a failure; adminClearOnly, caps and human review are the defence (J16, OJ6).

scenarios.title: Contested admin: operator pause, force-admin, OPERATOR_LOCK, the review API drops the old admin
